title: Handling Delays & Bad News

expressions.expr: I'm afraid I have some bad news
expressions.meaning: Receio que eu tenha uma má notícia
expressions.example: I'm afraid I have some bad news about your part.

expressions.expr: I'm really sorry about the delay
expressions.example: I understand, and I'm really sorry about the delay.

expressions.expr: I can't change the shipping, but I can visit you on Saturday
expressions.meaning: Não posso mudar o frete, mas posso te visitar no sábado
expressions.example: I can't change the shipping time, but I can visit you first on Saturday.
Thank you for your patience, Marcos. I will call you on Friday.

sentences: I'm afraid I have some bad news about your part.
The wiring harness did not arrive today.
Unfortunately, the supplier is late this week.
I'm really sorry about the delay.
It will arrive on Friday morning.
I promise I will call you as soon as it is here.
There is no extra charge for the weekend visit.

grammar.title: Dando má notícia com profissionalismo: I'm afraid… / I can't…, but I can…
rules: Use "I'm afraid…" (Receio que…) antes da notícia ruim para preparar o cliente com educação.
Use "Unfortunately, …" (Infelizmente, …) no início da frase, sempre seguido de vírgula.
Peça desculpa pelo atraso com "I'm really sorry about the delay." (sorry about + substantivo).
Nunca deixe o "não" sozinho: use "I can't [o que não dá], but I can [a alternativa]".

rows: I'm afraid the part is late.
I'm really sorry about the delay.
I can't ship today, but I can come Saturday.
